attributes.board_name: Arizona State Board of Physical Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 10 contact hours from Category A (courses approved by an accredited medical/health care/PT program, a state or national medical/health care/PT association or a national specialty society; specialty certification, residency or postgraduate PT coursework; 60 minutes = 1 contact hour); max 5 Category A hours nonclinical. Max 10 hours from Categories B and C (study group, self-instruction, in-service incl. CPR, practice management coursework, teaching at 2.5 h per 60 min, publication, clinical instruction at 1 h per 120 h; each max 5 h; max 5 nonclinical). Rounds, staff meetings, lay presentations and routine teaching are not accepted.
rules.new_licensee_rule: If the initial license is for one year or less: 10 contact hours of Category A in the initial compliance period (max 5 nonclinical).
rules.audit_note: Signed statement on the renewal application; random audit with notice within 60 days after the renewal deadline, proof due within 30 days. Keep evidence for two compliance periods.
rules.legal_basis: Ariz. Admin. Code R4-24-401 to R4-24-403; A.R.S. Title 32, Ch. 19
rules.notes: Compliance period runs September 1 after licensure/renewal to August 31 of even-numbered years; renewal application due by August 31 of even years. No repeat credit for the same activity. No mandatory topics.

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 6 contact hours from Category A (max 3 nonclinical). Max 4 hours from Categories B and C (each activity type max 2 h; max 2 nonclinical).
rules.new_licensee_rule: If the initial license is for one year or less: 6 contact hours of Category A in the initial compliance period (max 3 nonclinical).
rules.audit_note: Signed statement on the renewal application; random audit, proof due within 30 days of notice. Keep evidence for two compliance periods.
rules.legal_basis: Ariz. Admin. Code R4-24-401 to R4-24-403; A.R.S. Title 32, Ch. 19
rules.notes: Compliance period runs September 1 after licensure/renewal to August 31 of even-numbered years. No mandatory topics.
